author_controls.scope: Original common/link_cleanup/supersede on temporary owned fixtures; not upstream tests.

confirmed_findings: cleanup_related_section reports missing link removed but keeps whole line if another link on line resolves; observed missing link remains in output.
cleanup_relative_section passes no source path to shared resolver; ./child valid relative to folder/source.md is rejected and Related section removed in owned fixture.
apply_supersede equal-date pair leaves old card bytes unchanged; positive refusal control.
source_only_findings: supersede dates compare lexicographic strings without date-format validation; read-only scan ranks same way. Malformed-date runtime not tested.
supersede main searches nested skill schema then load_schema default candidates including CWD, not vault-root schema.json directly; no CLI wrong-schema runtime claim.
link cleanup parses Related with regex and calls extract_wikilinks line-by-line; multiline fence context not retained. Source-only.
link cleanup deletes entire section when kept empty, but run_cleanup writes changed text only when removed nonempty; helper and CLI behavior scopes differ.
supersede stamps metadata using direct write_text and does not merge bodies; intended pointer-based archival, not canonical content consolidation.
